review_candidates.title: Senior Microsoft systems engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities: Deploy, administer, and optimize System Center suite components: SCCM (MECM), SCOM, and SCVMM. Support, maintain, and upgrade enterprise collaboration platforms (SharePoint Server 2016 & 2019). Automate routine administrative tasks and system deployments via PowerShell scripting. Requirements & Qualifications: 5+ years of solid experience in Microsoft enterprise infrastructure administration. Proven track record in administering and troubleshooting SharePoint 2016 and 2019.
eligibility_evidence: Ensure high availability, performance monitoring, and compliance across hybrid/on-premise Microsoft server infrastructure.
Microsoft certifications (e.g., MCSE, Azure/Hybrid Administrator) are a strong plus.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Senior Microsoft Systems Engineer to join our Infrastructure team. If you have deep expertise in the Microsoft System Center suite, Active Directory identity solutions, and SharePoint enterprise deployments, we’d like to hear from you. Requirements & Qualifications: 5+ years of solid experience in Microsoft enterprise infrastructure administration. In-depth hands-on experience with SCCM, SCOM, and SCVMM. Proficiency in Active Directory, Group Policies, DNS, and PowerShell automation.
